item.title: PulseMRR 0.9.17
item.description:
• More accurate MRR, with the rules of a real SaaS admin board:
    • Real MRR counts active subscriptions only, at list price. Failed payments and invoices Stripe gave up on move to At risk, outside the MRR.
    • Trials: cancelled trials no longer count, and trials cancelling are shown apart.
    • Smarter projection: each ended trial is told apart (paid, failed payment, cancelled by the customer, once per customer), and each running trial is weighted by the pay rate at its age.
    • Churn of paying customers only, with the reason (cancellation or failed payment), subscriptions about to end, and churn since the start.
  • Excluded emails per project in Settings, to leave internal or test accounts out of every figure.
  • Deleted Stripe customers are left out everywhere.
